THING_MODEL.SPECIFICATIONS:
Signal Generator
Produces analog, digital or Environment periodic outputs that follow a set of common signal curves.  

Features:
  • Generates signals of the following shapes: cosine[_inv], square[_inv] (with duty cycle), triangle[_inv] (with adjustable apex), minimum, maximum. 
  • It can be customized by changing values of variables (see below) inside main.js with names that start with prefix V_. Look for an example signal-generator.pkt in Packet Tracer samples.
  • Signals are generated in the range from 0 to 1 and then scaled to the user value range defined by V_MIN and M_MAX.
  • V_NAME can be set to name the signal with user-chosen text (Pressure, Flow, etc.)
  • V_CURVE_TYPE can be set to: triangle[_inv], cosine[_inv], zero, one, square[_inv]. Where _inv suffix is given, the cirve will be flipped upside within its value range.
  • V_CURVE_PARAM defines a value from 0 to 1 with the following semantics:
    • triangle[_inv] - determines position of the triangle apex along the time axis. Value of 0.5 - wave is an equilateral triangle, value of 0 - apex is at the leftmost edge of its period, value of 1 - apex is at the rightmost edge of its period. 
    • square[_inv] - determines the signal's duty cycle.
  • V_OUT_D variable determine digital outputs the final value will be applied to. The variable holds index values of the desired output pins. V_OUT_D array may be empty. In this case no values will be output.
  • V_OUT_A variable determines analog outputs the final value will be applied to. The variable holds index values of the desired output pins. V_OUT_A array may be empty. In this case no values will be output.
  • V_STEPS_PER_PERIOD defines how many samples will be produced for every period length of time for a given curve. The higher this number, the more accurately samples will represent the actual curve.
  • V_TICKS_PER_STEP defines how many loop() iterations it takes to produce one sample.
  • V_TICK_DELAY defines how long every loop() iteration sleeps before it moves to the next tick.
Usage:
  • Use this device as a signal output device connecting it to inputs of other devices that require analog or digital inputs.
